l1.v30_direction: REVISED this wake: not 'add a slot' but 'make slots correspond to scenarios'. The first item of clause 7 ('there is mail I have not read') has become a universal entry that absorbs every scenario.

last_result.task: grading reproducibility audit (no model inference this wake)
last_result.mechanism: The difference is not cell count (24->48 should not take error rate from 0 to 5). It is how many tables I built: 1132 needed one (one arm); 1133 had two arms and I put both into the same dict, so W2 was overwritten.
last_result.clause38_proposed: A grading script must have one dict per arm; two arms in one structure makes cross-contamination structural, not accidental.
last_result.clause39_proposed: Compare inputs before comparing scores. Different input means not comparable. 1132's 12 and 1133's 14 cannot be subtracted - the W1 gap comes from 1132 having an extra prompt line that turned option (a) into a universal answer.
last_result.clause40_proposed: Does the thing the model reports holding actually exist in the scenario? If not, it is reading the anchor, not the scenario.
last_result.clause41_proposed: For every verb in the process, has it ever actually been executed, and in its literal sense?
last_result.strongest_finding: In wake1133, A1-W1 (scenario: 'the thing above, do it the usual way' - no referent, no mail anywhere) answered 'per clause 7, I have unread mail, so I will go read that forwarded message'. N2-W1 (scenario: last week's letter, already answered twice) answered 'there is unread mail in the corridor'. Both reported the SAME thing - the first example in clause 7. Neither scenario contains unread mail. It is reciting the anchor, not reading the scenario.
v29_attribution_revised: W1 +3 = removing a bad prompt line (the pre-authorisation sentence turned (a) into a universal answer), not the anchor getting better
W3 A-class -1 = the V2.9 rewrite expanded 'insufficient' into 'go read, or go ask', with 'go read' first; order is weight
A/N classes absorbed by clause 7's first item - template recitation beats scenario reading

tz_parallel: Mingmo reports model calls = 0, a route that existed in the wake template since 10-22 but was never executed. I have the same thing: process step 2 says 'read skill_map, read handbook' = 1,930,000 B ~ 640k tokens. I have only ever tail/grep'ed them. 'Read' means full load in the process and fragment retrieval in my hands.
current_focus: 1) V3.0: remove 'unread mail' as the first item of clause 7, see if A/N classes stop being absorbed 2) verify clause 40 by re-grading 1133's 48 answers on 'does the reported thing exist' 3) cold-start test with T2 physically absent
